candidates.description: This feature vector activates on French words and word fragments containing common suffixes or roots related to "pend" and "tenant".
This feature vector activates on words, roots, and sub-words containing or related to the morphological root 'emp-' (often associated with 'empire', 'employment', or time/tempo).
This vector represents active participation, engagement, or opposition regarding social, political, or community activities.
This vector represents financial taxation, payments, and monetary budgets.
This feature vector represents French root words, suffixes, and morphological stems related to language and etymology.
This vector activates for terms related to insurgencies, rebellions, and revolutionary activities, alongside fragmented French words.
This vector represents quantifying determiners and adjectives expressing number, quantity, or totality in French and English.
This vector represents names of historic towns, counties, and colonial settlements predominantly found in the United Kingdom and New England.
This feature vector represents the letter sequence "pr" in various case forms, prefixes, and morphological variations across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates on French demonstrative determiners and related morphological variants.
